items.title: Introducing network calls in Amazon CloudFront Functions
items.summary: Amazon CloudFront lets you securely deliver static and dynamic content with low latency and high transfer speeds. With CloudFront Functions, you can run business logic such as redirecting requests, selectively routing to alternate origin, or modifying headers at every CloudFront edge location with low latency and scale. Today, we are introducing network calls in CloudFront […]
